adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when content changes it uses `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)`. In Rails, `update_column` intentionally skips callbacks/validations and does not touch timestamp columns like `updated_at`, so the row’s `updated_at` will not reflect the last time the embed was successfully re-synced even though `content_sha1` changed. The diff doesn’t show any current code relying on `topic_embeds.updated_at`, so this is a real but forward-looking correctness/maintainability concern rather than a present defect.
